title: The kbmon-pane mod shows kbmon live in a pane and gives the agent only the receipt
goal: a plugin of function hooks in .claude/skills/kbmon-pane loads in every session of the clone and does nothing in a session whose session.start says isInteractive false; in an interactive session it opens a kbmon pane that a 60-second timer fills with kbmon.py --once at the pane's columns, finding Python as python3, python or py -3; after a resize it lays the pane out again at the new width within one refresh; /kbmon opens the pane again; a toast tells the person when the alert set changes; the agent gets the kbmon.py --receipt line as one appended user-role row at session start and another only when the fingerprint changes

run:
import shutil,subprocess as s,sys
c=shutil.which('claude')
if not c:
    print('claude is not on PATH');sys.exit(1)
p=s.run([c,'plugin','validate','.claude/skills/kbmon-pane'],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=180);o=p.stdout+p.stderr
need=['session.start','ui.render{component=Pane','command.run{command=kbmon}','$.process.run','$.session.append','$.ui.toast','$.clock.every','$.ui.open']
miss=[n for n in need if n not in o]
if p.returncode!=0 or 'Validation passed' not in o or miss:
    print(o[-1200:]);print('missing:',miss);sys.exit(1)
print('ok: the mod validates and hooks and calls what the goal names')

import glob,sys
t=''.join(open(f,encoding='utf-8').read() for f in glob.glob('.claude/skills/kbmon-pane/hooks/**/*.ts*',recursive=True))
need=['isInteractive','--receipt','--once','bodyColumns',"'-3'",'60_000']
miss=[n for n in need if n not in t]
print('missing:',miss) if miss else print('ok');sys.exit(1 if miss else 0)

clauses.clause: a plugin of function hooks in .claude/skills/kbmon-pane loads in every session of the clone and does nothing in a session whose session.start says isInteractive false
in an interactive session it opens a kbmon pane that a 60-second timer fills with kbmon.py --once at the pane's columns, finding Python as python3, python or py -3
after a resize it lays the pane out again at the new width within one refresh
a toast tells the person when the alert set changes
the agent gets the kbmon.py --receipt line as one appended user-role row at session start and another only when the fingerprint changes

notes: Plan 2026-10-19 (operator choices): the receipt comes from the mod, not settings hooks, since session.start's isInteractive (false for -p and the SDK) is the one documented headless signal; the mod lives in .claude/skills/kbmon-pane and loads with no install and no settings change. Prototype in the discovery session (scratchpad, --plugin-dir): the pane docked as a sidebar at 170 columns, clipped at once on a resize and was laid out again at the new width after one kbmon run (about 20 s); the demo agent quoted only the receipt row, nothing of the pane. Checks: claude plugin validate and a read of the module; no check runs the mod, since claude plugin test needs a *.test.ts file, which the operator ruled out (D-6kei5o2z, D-2tq4fhgs), and a live session makes a model call. The mods API is early access (bundled reference, Claude Code 2.1.290; this host runs 2.1.303).
